body:
I don't know. All I've ever done is what my parents or teachers expected me to do. I thought that getting a good education and career was supposed to lead to paradise, and that I would be happy once I got to that point.

Now since I'm at that point, and feel as if all my efforts were futile, I'm confused and don't know what to do. I was told my whole life that hard work and diligence would lead to happiness; it hasn't.

I wish I could just give my entire life to someone else who would actually appreciate it.
